Tamil Nadu Secretariat Project Faces Opposition Over Environment and Livelihood Concerns

The Tamil Nadu government's plan to build a new secretariat has drawn opposition from some of its allies and fishermen. The project is facing criticism regarding its potential environmental impact and its effect on the livelihoods of local fishermen. Protests have been organized by fishermen against the proposed construction.
